verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's reading order and has legible, well-proportioned flavour pills. However, the headline and subhead run over the stacked yellow circles, the headline almost touches the right edge, and the CTA is squeezed between the subhead and pills with an awkward right offset, so the bottom block feels cramped. B puts the SOLSTICE wordmark below the headline, which breaks the brand-then-headline order, and shrinks the flavour pills until their labels can't be read. It also reverses the pill order and leaves the left third as nothing but empty circles, while the subhead runs right up to the right edge.
